subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers repair this branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback, or route the canonical fix to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 instead?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping open candidate work, and this branch still has proof, message-delivery, and security-boundary blockers that automation cannot fully resolve without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower predicate, action metadata preservation, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use the other candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes the proof-accepted canonical implementation for the same three paths.

options.title: Waive live proof deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source-level proof, but the code-review blockers still need repair before merge.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower predicate, action metadata preservation, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership history covers the affected Google Chat API and message-action upload paths.
